tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Investors are expressing concerns over Anthropic's financial data. Still open, per Futurism: the company's $17B revenue doesn't justify its $2T valuation.
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash released a new version on 1017. Reported by 手机新浪网: the update enables wish-based programming for game and 3D modeling tasks.
UK government officials are alarmed about artificial intelligence risks. Confirmed by The Guardian: ministers warn the technology poses serious threats from hacking to bioweapons.
Many websites have become invisible to ChatGPT without owner knowledge. Reported by Yonkers Times: Cloudflare blocks artificial intelligence crawlers by default across its network.
European regulators are delaying artificial intelligence enforcement rules. Reported by BornCity: the EU asked OpenAI and Anthropic for details amid security incidents.
Free every hour.
